decision: Close the representation pilot BOUNDED_UNRESOLVED at its nonrenewable 8/8 tooling-attempt cap, with no variants or checker launches. Select the existing one-thread determinism item as the highest-value feasible READY successor without starting it; retain the nine discovery proposals behind their recorded scientific promotion gates.

categories.assessment: The failed supervisor boundary supplies no representation result and does not justify reopening the frozen item. The source-only one-thread assessment is the only currently executable method question; pipeline completeness remains a stronger future frontier after its protocol gate is made concrete.

The representation design and failures are preserved but its unvalidated controller is retired. The one-thread item can still yield a deterministic protocol or precise operational boundary from retained evidence; pipeline completeness could later create a reusable checked-object sentinel.

No executed pair, defect, reusable validated controller or upstream action emerged from the stopped pilot. Existing contribution drafts and dated upstream observations retain their own gates. The selected successor is read-only and performs no external action.

The completed pilot's source review found relevant metamorphic-testing context but no reusable NDJSON reordering implementation. The one-thread plan already binds its source/evidence base; pipeline completeness still needs an item-specific reuse and receipt-semantics review before promotion.

No bounded repair remains inside the exhausted representation item. The one-thread source assessment is locally feasible now. Pipeline completeness is not externally blocked, but its missing producer/adapter and checked-object receipt protocol is a real scientific entry gate and should not be invented during this closure.

candidates.rationale: It remains READY, unstarted, locally answerable from retained source/evidence, and strictly bounded to eight inspections with no network or execution launches. That gives it a concrete completion path after the representation tooling cap ended.

It remains the highest-ranked planned discovery proposal and may offer strong shared assurance value, but it does not yet have an item-specific staged protocol or exact checked-object receipt semantics.

blockers.reason: Name supported producer/adapters, independently expected module contents, checked-object receipt semantics, omission/substitution/truncation controls, and finite setup/tooling/process/memory caps in a staged item plan before promotion.
